data.name: Siesta Hotel
data.address: Grand Anse Beach, Morne Rouge, Grenada
data.description:
Set on a hillside of whitewashed properties, this unassuming hotel is 8 minutes' walk from Grand Anse Beach, 3 km from the town of Belmont and 6 km from Maurice Bishop International Airport.
Featuring balconies, the unpretentious rooms offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges, plus safes. The 1- and 2-bedroom apartments feature kitchens, and separate living rooms with pull-out sofas.
Parking is complimentary. There's an airy restaurant, an outdoor pool and a sundeck, plus bay views. Airport transfers are available for a fee.
